summary.name: Meta Evolution / Meta Core
summary.description: Minecraft Bedrock superhero behavior/resource pack knowledge base extracted from uploaded pack files.
summary.obtainment: The included guide says abilities are gained through injections, suits, or special items. The uploaded pack contains a crafting item catalog and many ability/suit/special item identifiers. Only two recipe folders were present but no recipe JSON files were found, so exact crafting recipes may need to be added manually if they exist elsewhere.
controls: Flight: double jump toggles hover; look and walk to fly; look and sprint for faster flight; Flight item changes speed levels.

Web-swinging: aim at a block and hold interact with Web Swing item; tap interact for web-zip; look up while holding to hang; crouch/look up or down to ascend/descend; crouch + look down + tap can ground slam.
Guide book item: mc:guide_book opens the in-pack guide.

guide.title: Abilities
guide.body:
Abilities are the core of Meta Core.

You gain abilities through injections, suits, or special items. Each ability may have:
• Cooldowns
• Energy usage
• Scaling levels

Examples:
- Heat Vision → Damage beam attack, damage scales with level
- Super Speed → Faster movement with different levels
- Thunderclap → Area shockwave with cooldown, and damage, knockback, and radius that scale with level

Tip:
Some abilities work better together — experiment with combos!

guide.title: Flight
guide.body:
Flight allows you to move freely in the air.

Controls:
• Double jump → Toggle hover (jump again to stop)
• Look and Walk → Fly in looking direction
• Look and Sprint → Faster flight in looking direction

Tips:
• Use the Flight item to change speed levels

guide.title: Web-Swinging
guide.body:
Web-swinging lets you attach to surfaces and swing like a superhero.

How it works:
• Aim at a block
• Hold Interact with Web Swing Item to shoot a web and swing with momentum physics
• Tap Interact with Web Swing Item to Web-Zip
• Hold Interact with Web Swing Item While looking directly up to hang in place (Crouching while looking up or down will make you ascend/descend)
• Tap Interact with Web Swing Item while looking directly down and Crouching to do a ground slam attack

Tips:
• Higher angles = longer swings
• Chain swings for speed boosts
• Release at the peak for max distance

Best used in cities or tall structures.

guide.title: Combat
guide.body:
Combat in Meta Core is ability-based.

You can:
• Use ranged abilities (beams, lightning)
• Use melee boosts (strength, knockback)
• Combine movement + attacks

Examples:
• Dash → Punch combo
• Web trap → Finish with beam
• Thunderclap to create distance → Attack with a ranged ability

Tip:
Fighting IQ matters more than raw power.

guide.title: Gear System
guide.body:
Some abilities are affected by gear or suits.

Gear can modify:
• Damage
• Speed
• Cooldowns
• Special effects

Higher-tier gear = stronger abilities.

guide.title: Injections
guide.body:
Injections grant permanent or semi-permanent powers.

Each injection may:
• Add abilities
• Apply passive buffs
• Unlock new mechanics

Examples:
• Thor Injection → Lightning abilities
• Speed Injection → Movement boosts

Note:
Injections may interact with tags for scaling.

guide.title: Scaling
guide.body:
Scaling controls how strong abilities become.

Basic Formula:
Speed = base + (level × multiplier)

Example:
Base = 1
Level = 5
Multiplier = 0.2

Result:
Speed = 2

Use scaling to balance progression.

guide.title: Tags System
guide.body:
Tags are the backbone of Meta Core.

Tags control:
• Ability activation
• Scaling Levels
• Colors of abilities

Examples:
• level_1 → Weak ability
• level_10 → Strong ability
• level_100 → Insane ability

Tip:
Always check tags before applying effects.

guide.title: Creating Abilities
guide.body:
Steps to create an ability:

1. Define item (trigger)
2. Detect item use
3. Apply effect (damage, motion, etc.)
4. Add cooldown system (OPTIONAL)
5. Use tags for scaling (OPTIONAL)

Example abilities:
• Beam attack
• Dash
• AoE explosion

Keep logic modular for easy expansion.

guide.title: Optimization
guide.body:
Performance tips:

• Avoid constant loops when possible
• Use system.runInterval wisely
• Cache player data
• Use tags instead of heavy calculations

Bad:
Running logic every tick for all players

Good:
Run only when needed (events)

guide.title: Advanced Tips
guide.body:
Advanced creator tips:

• Combine abilities for unique mechanics
• Use particles + sound for feedback
• Add cooldown indicators
• Balance power vs usability

Goal:
Make abilities feel powerful AND fun.
